rows.en:
(So, what kind of clothes should I buy
in the Shibuya Area today? There are so many
shops, it's hard to choose...)

(Wait, is that Luis-san
coming out of that shop?)
Luis-saaan!

Hm? If it isn't Fresh Boy.
What are you doing here?

I'm just doing a little shopping today...
You came out of a clothing store, Luis-san.
What did you buy?
Just a couple of slick T-shirts.

Like this zebra-print T-shirt,
or this one with a tiger printed on it...
They're slick as heck, right?
rows.notes: zeburaa-gara: Luis's drawn-out 'zebra'; rendered plainly as zebra-print.

rows.en:
Next time, I'll pick out one that'd suit you,
so look forward to it.
Thank you very much...
Well, see ya.

(No matter what T-shirt Luis-san gives me,
I'd better actually wear it, huh...)

(Hmm, Luis-san's always like that,
so I can't picture him ever being flustered...)

(Oh, it's Luis-san.
Perfect timing...)
Hm? You need somethin' from me, Fresh Boy?

This is out of the blue, but...
Luis-san, is there anything
you can't stand?

Whoa, whoa, young man...
If you think I'd hand over my weak point
that easily, you're way too naive, y'know?

Oh, right, of course...
Sorry for asking something weird.
Tch, you got that right...

Just so you know, I don't tell this to just anybody.
I'm telling you 'cause it's you.
(Oh, he's going to tell me...)

Even a man who loves all humanity like me
just can't love octopuses or slimy critters,
sad to say...
Don't tell anyone, Fresh Boy.

Listen... Don't you ever, EVER
tell anyone!!
Do you really get it? Listen, never ever......

(If he's gonna warn me that relentlessly,
I wish I'd never asked in the first place...)

(Huh? The one running on the field is...)
(Luis-san?)

Luis-saaan!
What are you doing here?

Yo, if it isn't Fresh Boy.
Oh, I'm just doing my daily training.

(I don't think he needs to sneak
into the school to do it...)

If I slack off on my training,
my precious muscles'll get sad.

All right, you're training with me!
And fire up those muscles! That passion!!

Huh? Um, no, I already had
Hilda-sensei's class today, so...

Then let's go!
Follow me, Fresh Boy!!

(Somehow it's already been decided
that I'm joining his training...)
Hurry up! I'll leave you in the dust!

what are you up to?

I was bored, so I went for a walk.
What about you, Luca?
I just got back from a trip.

A trip, huh~
Sounds like you're having a great summer break.
N-Not really...
All I'm doing is loafing around.

Ahaha...
Well then, I'll be heading home.
(...Guess I'll head home too.)
